summary: Adds summary heartbeat, bounded round budget, Impact Oracle Matrix, evidence provenance grades, and case-learned oracle defaults after ahe-humanize-guarded-v2 resolved 0/3.
rationale: PEP615 timed out before summary or review, so stricter reviewer rules never executed. PEP646 and PEP680 reached accepted completion while hidden failures mapped to missing oracle families: future annotations, type-hints, unparse roundtrips, upstream TOML fixtures, exact errors, exception constructor behavior, and parse_float validation. This variant changes the schema so those families must be named and audited before PACT_COMPLETE.
meaningful_difference: Compared with ahe-humanize-guarded-v2, this variant treats hidden-failure signatures as missing oracle families rather than generic verification weakness. Workers must publish an early heartbeat, choose a bounded vertical slice, maintain an Impact Oracle Matrix, and grade evidence provenance. Reviewers must reject missing required oracle families even when public verification passes.

predicted_case_effects.prediction: Worker should publish an early summary heartbeat and choose a bounded zoneinfo slice; reviewer should block missing weird TZif, TZ string, fold/gap/fromutc, cache/weakref, pickle/path, and C/Python parity oracle rows.

Reviewer should block completion unless parser, AST validation, compiler/runtime behavior, future annotations, typing.get_type_hints, unparse cosmetic slice roundtrips, and negative syntax cases are covered.

Reviewer should treat local synthetic corpus as partial and require upstream-compatible valid/invalid fixtures, exact errors, exception behavior, parse_float failure behavior, and relevant public API coverage.
